meta.title: TiE Siliguri — Fostering Entrepreneurship in North Bengal
meta.description: TiE Siliguri is the North Bengal chapter of TiE, the world's largest network of entrepreneurs. Mentoring, learning, networking, funding and incubation for the entrepreneurs of Siliguri.

hero.headline: Where Siliguri's entrepreneurs
hero.subhead: TiE Siliguri brings the world's largest entrepreneurial network to North Bengal — connecting the region's most ambitious founders and business leaders to mentorship, capital, and a global stage.
hero.imageAlt: Charter Members of TiE Siliguri together at a chapter gathering
hero.subheadShort: The world's largest entrepreneurial network, now in North Bengal — connecting the region's founders to mentorship, capital and a global stage.

intro.headline: A global movement. A local mission
body: TiE brings together entrepreneurs, mentors, investors and business leaders through a global ecosystem built around education, networking, investing, incubation and mentoring.
In Siliguri, that global philosophy is being translated into a platform for North Bengal's entrepreneurs to learn, collaborate and grow — and to put this region firmly on India's entrepreneurial map.
intro.imageAlt: TiE Siliguri chapter launch on stage, 30 July 2025

pillars.headline: A platform made for entrepreneurs
pillars.subhead: There are many ways to gather business leaders. TiE is designed for one sharper outcome: entrepreneurial transformation.

cta.title: See why North Bengal's founders are joining TiE Siliguri.
cta.label: Why join TiE

items.title: Mentoring
items.body: One-on-one guidance from founders who have already built at scale — through mentorship clinics and our Charter Member network.

items.title: Learning
items.body: Practitioner-led masterclasses on sales, strategy, branding, AI and growth. Nine in our first year alone.

items.title: Networking
items.body: Curated coffee meets, member mixers and cross-chapter access that turn introductions into real partnerships.

items.title: Funding
items.body: Pathways to angel capital and investor readiness through TiE Angels and the wider TiE investing network.

items.title: Incubation
items.body: Structured support for early-stage ventures — from problem diagnosis to go-to-market execution.

yearOne.headline: One year. Real momentum
yearOne.body: TiE Siliguri launched on 30 July 2025 with Mr. Murali Bukkapatnam, Chairman of the TiE Global Board of Trustees, as Chief Guest. From early ecosystem conversations to flagship residencies, the community has moved well beyond intent.

programs.headline: Where founders go deeper
programs.subhead: Practitioner-led programmes with the time and access to change how a business runs — taught by operators who have built at scale.

items.name: AI Immersion Residency
items.summary: A two-day residential immersion built to take founders from AI curiosity to AI capability — mindset, prompt engineering, workflow design and building your own AI edge.
items.imageAlt: Members at a TiE Siliguri workshop session

items.name: Founders' Immersion — Masters' Union
items.summary: An exclusive, practitioner-led programme for founders and family business owners, hosted inside an ecosystem of Fortune 500 companies at Masters' Union School of Business.
items.imageAlt: A speaker addressing TiE Siliguri members

membership.subhead: Whether you are building your first venture or running an established business, there is a seat at the table — and a role to play.

trust.headline: Trusted by leading organisations
trust.body: Across TiE chapters and programs, leading organisations have partnered with TiE to strengthen entrepreneurial ecosystems.
trust.punchline: Great brands don't just market to entrepreneurs. They invest in entrepreneurial ecosystems.
